classification: participant path-execution repair plus presentation-only locomotion pass; no game-rule or map change

hypotheses.coreFlow: near-reactor stalls are traffic or route-execution failures that the same-tile/same-life bar does not completely describe
hypotheses.motion: authoritative movement reads like sliding tokens because translation and facing are truthful but locomotion does not communicate forward, reverse, and lateral intent

repairOrder: stock player-sheet algorithm if the v3 re-read trips
obsolete hand-authored doctrine only if it remains in the replacement gallery

acceptance.forensics: every tripping current-gallery episode has a tick range, Core, side, position history, and classified cause
acceptance.detector: the owner-observed stationary cases trip and synthetic same-team handoff and two-tile oscillation cases cannot evade the bar
acceptance.population: every retained player-sheet cell passes v3 under canonical WASM evidence; any repaired sheet or algorithm is re-run rather than re-scored in place
acceptance.presentation: planar positions, authoritative facing, hit timing, vision, and canonical replay bytes remain unchanged while forward, reverse, lateral, and turn motion receive visibly distinct renderer-owned cues
acceptance.review: a fresh twelve-match gallery contains only v3-eligible current player-sheet cells and deliberately covers movement relations plus carrier approaches and banks

prohibitions: no class-stat, rules, cadence, or map change
no threshold movement after repaired outcomes are read
no fun claim without owner review
